confirmed.evidence: The only structured ram_system_headroom warning is run 010 fold 5. Available RAM crossed the 10 GiB reserve for 18 samples, reached 9.71 GiB, never crossed the unchanged 8 GiB abort floor, recovered to 24.84 GiB, and the run completed.
Run 011 resource_usage.json has no warnings and minimum available RAM 16.39 GiB. Its manifest/checkpoint/index record manual_interrupt/interrupted while the worker was in fold 3 voter_boruta.
No run-011 sample crossed an abort threshold, so the original supervisor never entered its resource-stop join/terminate path. The blocking estimator continued until the user interrupt.
In the pre-patch supervisor, KeyboardInterrupt around the resource-triggered join unconditionally assigned manual_interrupt and could erase an already assigned resource code.
The pre-patch supervisor did not persist lifecycle transitions/owned PID identities, used unbounded queue draining, and did not cancel queue feeder joins explicitly.
Observed worker peaks rose from about 2.3 GiB on Home Credit to 7.85, 12.50, and 8.86 GiB on LendingClub runs 009-011, consistent with the larger frozen workload and prior isolated capacity evidence.

plausible_but_unproven.evidence: The historical sampler recorded total available RAM but no system-wide per-process memory snapshot.
The original release did not record parent PID/RSS before and after each run, so small parent retention cannot be quantified.

not_supported.evidence: Run 010 ended at 24.84 GiB available and run 011 began at 25.41 GiB, higher than the 24.06 GiB start of run 001.

Each run used a distinct worker PID, historical samples observed no descendants for runs 001-011, and the immutable baseline found no repository Python process after the incident. Exact disappearance latency was not recorded.
The research worker contract returns a compact summary/additional-artifact mapping. Run 011 never returned a scientific payload because it was interrupted inside selection.
Run 011 remained inside RandomForest/joblib according to the traceback; no result publication or queue-flush stage had been reached.

contradicted.evidence: Run 011 has zero reserve-warning samples, zero abort-floor samples, stop_code manual_interrupt, and minimum available RAM more than twice the abort floor.
The preserved Prompt 5.1 largest-fold and full-DEV scenarios completed under clean isolated conditions with exact mechanics equivalence.

unknown: Historical parent RSS before/after each run.
A per-process snapshot of unrelated system consumers at the run-010 reserve warning.
conclusion: Run 011 was not a failed resource-stop execution; it was a long blocking fold-3 Boruta computation ended by a manual interrupt. The patch nevertheless repairs the confirmed latent precedence, ownership, escalation, queue-finalization, compact-payload, and inter-run-readiness weaknesses.
